events.title: Constantius II dies, leaving Julian sole emperor
events.description: Constantius II died in Cilicia while marching against his cousin Julian, who became sole Roman emperor. Julian, the last pagan emperor, tried to revive traditional cults but was killed fighting Persia in 363.

events.title: Henry VII and Charles VIII make peace at Étaples
events.description: The Peace of Étaples ended Henry VII's brief invasion of France: Charles VIII paid him a large sum and agreed to stop supporting Yorkist pretenders. The treaty helped secure the new Tudor dynasty.

events.title: Olympe de Gouges is guillotined
events.description: The playwright Olympe de Gouges, author of the Declaration of the Rights of Woman and of the Female Citizen, was executed during the Terror for writings attacking the Jacobins.
events.html: The playwright Olympe de Gouges, author of the Declaration of the Rights of Woman and of the Female Citizen, was executed during the Terror for writings attacking the Jacobins.

events.title: British and Chinese warships clash at Chuenpi
events.description: Royal Navy frigates fought Chinese war junks off Chuenpi near Canton, the first major clash of the First Opium War. The dispute followed Lin Zexu's destruction of British merchants' opium; China lost Hong Kong in 1842.

events.title: Laika becomes the first animal to orbit the Earth
events.description: The Soviet Union launched the dog Laika aboard Sputnik 2. She died within hours from overheating, but the flight showed a living creature could survive launch and weightlessness.
